trophies.guide: Use the full trophy list as your route: advance through the story while steadily closing out its separate activity and collection requirements, then audit everything still outstanding. Save time by combining nearby available activities into each free-roam trip and keeping a short outstanding-items checklist; the 80–140 hour allowance is this guide's untested estimate, not a measured route.
